record.paper_title: PURE O-SEQUENCES: KNOWN RESULTS, APPLICATIONS AND OPEN PROBLEMS
record.original_question: Determine the smallest codimension r for which there exists a nonunimodal pure O-sequence of socle degree 4.

evidence.quote: What is the smallest codimension r for which there exists a nonunimodal pure O-sequence of socle degree 4?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be a field and consider monomial ideals in the polynomial ring $k[x_1,\dots,x_r]$. For a finite, nonempty set $X$ of (monic) monomials in $x_1,\dots,x_r$ that is closed under taking divisors (an order ideal of monomials), let $h_i$ be the number of monomials in $X$ of degree $i$. The sequence $h(X) = (h_0, h_1, h_2, \dots, h_e)$, where $e$ is the largest degree of a monomial in $X$, is called a pure O-sequence (of socle degree $e$ and codimension $h_1 \le r$) if every monomial of $X$ divides some monomial of $X$ of degree exactly $e$. The sequence $(h_0,\dots,h_e)$ is said to be unimodal if there is an index $j$ with $h_0 \le h_1 \le \cdots \le h_j \ge h_{j+1} \ge \cdots \ge h_e$, and nonunimodal otherwise.

Determine the smallest positive integer $r$ for which there exists a nonunimodal pure O-sequence of socle degree $4$ and codimension $r$ (equivalently, with $h_1 = r$).
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open question in the survey on pure O-sequences. Searches turned up no published resolution: subsequent work (e.g., on unimodality of pure O-sequences of type three, or on Stanley's nonunimodal Gorenstein h-vector) addresses related but distinct cases. No source confirms a determination of the minimal codimension forcing nonunimodality at socle degree 4.

status_evidence.title: Pure O-Sequences: Known Results, Applications, and Open Problems
status_evidence.snippet: Survey listing open problems on pure O-sequences, including questions about smallest codimension where nonunimodality occurs.
status_evidence.claim: The question is listed as an open problem in the survey.

status_evidence.title: On the shape of a pure O-sequence
status_evidence.snippet: Boij-Migliore-Miró-Roig-Nagel-Zanello establish that socle degree 3 pure O-sequences are unimodal and exhibit nonunimodal examples in higher socle degree.
status_evidence.claim: Nonunimodal pure O-sequences of socle degree 4 exist, but the minimal codimension is not pinned down.

status_evidence.title: The unimodality of pure O-sequences of type three in three variables
status_evidence.snippet: Studies unimodality in restricted cases of pure O-sequences.
status_evidence.claim: Related partial progress, but does not determine the minimal codimension for nonunimodal socle degree 4.
